title: IllusionGameEEG_data
description: This dataset contains EEG, physiological (ECG, PPG, respiration) and behavioural recordings from 103 healthy adults aged 21-45. Participants completed an 8-minute eyes-closed resting state, followed by an Illusion Game task that measures sensitivity to the Ebbinghaus, Müller-Lyer and Vertical-Horizontal visual illusions. Stimuli were generated with Pyllusion, with varying task difficulty and illusion strength. The task was administered as part of a larger study.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel EasyCap and BrainVision system using the 10-5 electrode placement, with impedance below 12 kOhm and a 10000 Hz sampling rate. Physiological signals (ECG, PPG, respiration) were recorded at 1000 Hz with PLUX OpenSignals and the BITalino toolkit. The Illusion Game comprised 384 trials in 6 blocks of 64, preceded by an 8-minute eyes-closed resting state and followed by an adapted Amsterdam Resting State Questionnaire.
